description:
Survey staking and lending opportunities on Base: APY, TVL, project and asset for each. 

Use this for breadth — browsing the market, answering 'what is available', or filtering a wide set. It covers pools this server cannot deposit into as well as ones it can.

Use something else when: you want one asset's single best option (`best_yield`); you intend to deposit and need a contract address (`list_lending_vaults`); you are judging one market rather than comparing many (`market_profile`).

Every row says where its number came from: `source` is `onchain` (read from the protocol's contracts at `block`, so the figure can be re-derived), `morpho-api`, or `defillama` — a third-party snapshot that carries no Moonwell USDC market at all and understates Aave's Base reserve.

Ranks by TVL unless sortByApy is set. Four-digit emission farms are filtered out by default. Returns market data, not a recommendation; any row's `pool` id can be passed to `yield_history`.

minTvl.description: Minimum total deposits in USD, e.g. 10000000 for $10M

sortByApy.description: True sorts by APY descending; default order is by TVL, largest first

name: list_base_yields
title: List Base yield opportunities
